verdict.rationale: Windmill documents an official CLI, `wmill`, for working with Windmill instances from the terminal, and it supports CLI deployments from a Git repository. That clearly delivers the core of the story. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-native or agent-oriented CLI workflows, detailed command coverage, independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Windmill CLI, `wmill` allows you to interact with Windmill instances right from your terminal.
as well as CLI deployments from a Git repository
